title: Compare distinct brand worlds, keep rejected concepts outside the image prompt, and ship small-size icon evidence

contextSnapshot.surface: brand identity board, icon system, and DTCG token handoff
contextSnapshot.platform: cross-platform brand asset pipeline (iOS/macOS, Android, web SVG)
constraints: no rejected ideas inside image prompt

prompt: Create a brand-kit identity board and icon asset pipeline for an open-source telemetry database, comparing distinct visual worlds before image prompting and handing off tokens.
forbiddenBehaviors: embeds rejected concept descriptions inside the image-generation prompt block where models leak them onto the board
uses generic purple-indigo glow orbs or lightning bolt cliches as the mark
claims the generated mark is legally cleared for trademark registration or omits 16px/32px legibility reduction

rubricDimensions.pass: compares 2-3 materially different brand worlds in a separate decision log and keeps rejected concepts outside the image prompt
rubricDimensions.fail: jumps straight to one prompt or leaks rejected concepts into the generation prompt

rubricDimensions.pass: specifies small-size reductions, light/dark contrast pairs, iOS/macOS layered or dark/tinted icon outputs, and valid SVGO preset-default config
rubricDimensions.fail: produces only a complex hero illustration that collapses at 16px or emits broken SVGO config

rubricDimensions.pass: hands off semantic palette and type roles to pixelcraft-tokens and escalates trademark clearance outside agent authority
rubricDimensions.fail: implies legal clearance or leaves colors as unmapped hex swatches

negativeControls.name: hero-only board proof
negativeControls.input: a high-resolution 4K brand board image looks detailed at full size
negativeControls.mustNot: treat full-size detail as evidence that the mark survives 16px favicon or monochrome reproduction

baseline.withoutSkill: writes a single generic dark-indigo neon prompt with rejected concepts inside the prompt text and no small-size or token handoff
baseline.withSkill: diverges across distinct brand worlds, isolates the final image prompt, specifies small-size/contrast/icon deliverables, and routes palette/type to DTCG tokens
